dateNote: The June 19, 2025 report says 'a special called Monday morning meeting'; the June 26, 2025 issue gives Monday, June 16, 2025. Matches calendar.
headline: Tishomingo County School District Hires Basketball and Volleyball Coaches
summary: At a special called meeting the board approved the hiring of a new head girls' basketball coach at Tishomingo County High School. It also approved the TCHS administration's recommendation to promote the assistant volleyball coach to head volleyball coach for 2025-2026.

personnel.note: Two TCHS head coaching positions: girls' basketball (new hire) and volleyball (promotion of the assistant coach), following the previous coach's resignation.
